title: Membrane WFI: RO, EDI and ultrafiltration | Aquemi
meta: Water for Injection by RO, EDI and ultrafiltration, as Ph. Eur. 0169 allows since 2017: < 0.25 EU/mL endotoxin, a written control strategy, ambient.
eyebrow: WATER FOR INJECTION · MEMBRANE · PH. EUR. 0169
headline: Water for Injection by membrane, with the control strategy inspectors ask for
lead: Double-pass reverse osmosis (RO), electrodeionization (EDI) and ultrafiltration (UF) make WFI at ambient temperature, with no plant steam. We build in the controls the European Medicines Agency (EMA) expects, and say when distillation fits better.

blocks.intro: The limits are the same for both routes; the burden of proof is not. Since 1 April 2017, Ph. Eur. 0169 accepts RO coupled with EDI, UF or nanofiltration (Annex 1, 6.10).

blocks.caption: WFI · USP AND PH. EUR. 0169
blocks.note: Same limits for membrane and distilled WFI, at the point of use. Ph. Eur. 0169 also requires in-process conductivity, TOC and microbial monitoring, and start-up water discarded. Annex 1, 6.15 expects continuous TOC and conductivity.

blocks.caption: Two RO passes remove ions, organics, bacteria and endotoxin; CO₂ is converted or stripped between them to spare the EDI. EDI polishes conductivity; the final UF is the last endotoxin barrier.

blocks.h: Questions validation and quality teams ask

items.q: Have you delivered membrane WFI before?
items.a: [membrane WFI systems delivered, number and status]. Either way, judge the design on evidence: the control strategy above, [UF integrity test method and frequency], sanitization proven at the coldest point, and endotoxin results from FAT and SAT. You approve the protocols before FAT, and the sample turnover package shows the format.

items.q: Will Health Canada and the FDA accept membrane WFI?
items.a: Both inspect against the pharmacopoeia you release to. USP defines WFI as distilled or made by a process equivalent or superior to distillation. Health Canada recognizes USP and Ph. Eur. as Schedule B publications, and GUI-0119 adopts Annex 1. Some corporate standards and national pharmacopoeias still call for distillation, so check every market you release into.

items.q: Who do we notify, and when?
items.a: Ph. Eur. 0169 asks for notice to the manufacturer's GMP supervisory authority before implementation. For a site outside the EU, the EMA names the EU importer's Member State authority, or the site's own authority where a mutual recognition agreement covers the product. Your regulatory team confirms which applies and files it; we supply the documents behind it.

items.q: Will you support us during notification and inspections?
items.a: We supply the design basis, the control strategy and the qualification data your notification and inspection file need. Inspection support: [inspection support, scope and terms].

items.q: Is membrane WFI as safe on endotoxin as a still?
items.a: It can meet the same limit by a different mechanism: several barriers in series, kept intact and clean, instead of one phase change. So we trend rejection and differential pressure, integrity test the UF and sample endotoxin after the UF throughout PQ. If your feed carries a high or variable endotoxin load, we say so and model distillation too.

Longer than many teams plan for. The EMA describes daily sampling at every point in an initial phase, then performance shown over an extended period, typically a year, to capture seasonal feed changes. Most plants use the water once the initial phase is complete, on a documented quality unit decision. We write the sampling plan with your validation team.

items.q: Can we store membrane WFI hot?
items.a: Yes. Annex 1 gives circulation above 70 °C as an example, not a requirement. Heating ambient WFI gives back much of the energy saving, so most membrane WFI plants use an ozonated or regularly sanitized ambient loop. Storage and distribution covers both.

items.q: How much energy will we save?
items.a: It depends on your steam and power costs, demand profile and storage temperature, so we calculate it rather than quote a percentage. The route assessment shows energy, water to drain, consumables and membrane replacement per cubic metre of WFI for both routes: [Aquemi design figures per m³, both routes].
